description: This file defines a plugin for processing markdown ASTs, specifically handling import directives by replacing them with imported content and validating import constraints.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Asynchronously parses a file with remark, applying the tableAndStrikeThrough plugin.

methods.name: plugin
methods.description: Returns the transformer function for processing ASTs.

methods.name: transformer
methods.description: Processes the AST to replace import directives with imported content, validating and removing import nodes.

methods.name: isImportNode
methods.description: Checks if a node is an import directive node.

methods.name: validateImports
methods.description: Validates that imported files do not contain editable region markers.
